aboutPage.description:
A custom quiz site is an interactive platform where users have the freedom to create their own quizzes in a simple and intuitive way. They can customize questions, answers, and even add visual elements such as images and videos to make their quizzes more engaging.

Once a user has created a quiz, they can share it with friends or the general public, encouraging participation and interaction. Participants can answer questions, view their results, and leave comments on the quiz. This commenting functionality allows for direct feedback, discussions, and social interaction, making the process a collaborative and fun experience.

In addition, the site offers a user-friendly interface and customization options, allowing creators to adapt their quizzes to a variety of topics, such as trivia, general knowledge, personality tests, and more. The idea is to encourage creativity while promoting sharing and interaction among users.

This dynamic environment transforms quizzes into a form of social entertainment, where anyone can be both a creator and a participant in custom quizzes.
aboutPage.privacy:
Our quiz site values your privacy and security. Therefore, we want to clarify that we only use strictly necessary cookies to ensure the proper functioning of our site. These cookies allow you to navigate and use all the features, such as taking quizzes and accessing your response history, efficiently and securely.

Additionally, we do not store sensitive payment information in our database. All payment processing is securely handled by Stripe, one of the most recognized and trusted payment platforms in the market. Stripe adheres to the highest standards of security and compliance, ensuring that your financial data is protected throughout the transaction process.

Our commitment is to provide a safe and transparent experience for all our users. If you have any questions or concerns about our privacy policy, we are here to help.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about creating quizzes
faq.intro: Quick answers about creating, publishing and sharing each type of quiz.
faq.question1Title: How do I create an online quiz?
faq.question1Text: Pick a type, write the questions and the alternatives, and publish. In trivia quizzes, online tests and about me quizzes you mark the correct answer; in personality quizzes each alternative points to a profile. Then share the link.
faq.question2Title: Can I create a quiz for free?
faq.question2Text: Yes. All four types are free with text questions, up to 10 per quiz. More than 10 questions, or images in questions and alternatives, need a subscription or a one-time credit. Stories, compatibility tests, points quizzes and tournaments with up to 16 options are free too; 32- and 64-option tournaments need a subscription or a one-time credit.
faq.question3Title: Can I make a quiz with a leaderboard?
faq.question3Text: Yes: trivia quizzes, online tests and about me quizzes have one, with each player's score and time. Personality quizzes don't rank anyone; you see who took part and which profile each person got.
faq.question4Title: Can I create an image quiz?
faq.question4Text: Yes. You can use images in questions and alternatives, which works well for visual challenges, characters, flags and logos. It's a paid feature, available with a subscription or a one-time credit.
faq.question5Title: Can I create an online test with an answer key?
faq.question5Text: Yes. In the Online test format you can write an optional explanation for each option. When students finish, they see their grade, what they got right and wrong, and your explanations.

faq.question: Can I create an online quiz with scores?

faq.question: How do I create an exam online?
faq.answer: Choose Online test, fill in the title, description and category, then write your questions with the right option and, if you like, an explanation for each option. When you publish, you get a link to send to your students.

faq.question: Is creating an online test on QuestioFlux free?
faq.answer: Yes. Text tests are free with up to 10 questions and 6 options per question. QuestioPlus unlocks unlimited questions, up to 15 options and images.

faq.question: Do students see the answer key after submitting?
faq.answer: They do. When they finish, they get their score and the full answer key: their answer, the right option and the explanations you wrote. Before they submit, the explanations stay hidden.

faq.question: Do students need an account?
faq.answer: No. Anyone without an account can answer as a guest, entering just a name for the leaderboard.

faq.question: Can I keep a test private?
faq.answer: Yes. A private test does not appear in Explore or on Google: only people with the link can take it.

faq.question: How do I make a quiz about myself?
faq.answer: Choose About me quiz, name your quiz, write questions about yourself (or use the suggestions), mark the right answer for each one and publish. Then just send the link.

faq.question: Do my friends need an account to answer?
faq.answer: No. They can answer as guests, with just a name to show on the leaderboard.

faq.question: How do I see who knows me best?
faq.answer: On the quiz leaderboard: whoever got the most right is on top and, between similar scores, whoever answered faster.

faq.question: How many questions can I add?
faq.answer: On the free plan, up to 10 questions with up to 6 options each. With QuestioPlus, questions are unlimited.

faq.question: Does my about me quiz show up on Google?
faq.answer: No. Quizzes about someone’s life stay out of search to protect the person who made them. They travel through the link you share.

faq.question: How do I make a personality quiz?
faq.answer: Choose Personality quiz, add the results on the cover (name, description and image), write the questions and choose which result each option leads to. Then publish it and share the link.

faq.question: How is the result calculated?
faq.answer: Each answer adds a point to the result it leads to, and the result with the most points wins. In a tie, the quiz can ask a tie-break question that only shows the tied results; without one, the tied results show up together as a combined result.

faq.question: How many results can I create?
faq.answer: Between 2 and 12 results per quiz, each with a name, a description and an optional image.

faq.question: Do people need an account to answer?
faq.answer: No. Anyone can answer without signing up and see their result right away.

faq.question: Can I use images in the questions?
faq.answer: Yes, with QuestioPlus: images in questions and options, just like the other quiz types. Result images are free.

index.title: Brackets, stories and tests to play with friends
index.lead: Besides quizzes with right answers, QuestioFlux has four formats where people pick favorites, choose paths, compare tastes or add up points. Each one has a playable example and a template you can edit.
index.heroNote: Free to create and to play. Playing doesn't even need an account.

faq.question: How are these formats different from a quiz?
faq.answer: Trivia quizzes and online tests have a right answer and a score. Here there is no right answer: the result is a champion, an ending, a compatibility percentage or a range of points.

faq.question: Are they free?
faq.answer: Yes. Creating, publishing and playing tournaments, stories, compatibility tests and points quizzes is free, including the images of tournament options.

faq.question: Do players need an account?
faq.answer: No. Anyone can play as a guest. In compatibility tests players choose a name, because the other person sees it in the comparison; in the other formats they can stay anonymous.

faq.question: Can I start from an example?
faq.answer: Yes. Each format page has a playable example and a “Use this template” button, which copies the content into a new draft for you to edit.

tournament.title: Create a favorites tournament bracket and find out who wins
tournament.lead: Choose 8, 16, 32 or 64 options, from pizzas to anime characters, and turn them into a tournament bracket. Each player picks a favorite in every duel until only the champion is left, and then sees which options win the most among everyone who played.
tournament.heroNote: Free up to 16 options, with an optional image for each one.

steps.title: Add the options
steps.text: Write 8 or 16 names (32 or 64 with QuestioPlus) and, if you want, add an image to each one.

steps.title: Publish and share
steps.text: Send the link or publish it in Explore. Every play draws a new bracket.

steps.title: See the favorites
steps.text: Each player sees their champion and its road to the title; the results tab shows which options win the most duels.

features.title: 8 to 64 options
features.text: 8 or 16 options are free: 7 or 15 duels. With QuestioPlus, 32 and 64 options give you 31 or 63 duels, great for streams and videos.

features.title: Images included
features.text: Each option can have a picture, which helps with food, characters, places and products. No subscription needed.

features.title: A champion for everyone
features.text: The result shows the champion and every opponent it beat along the way.

features.title: Everyone's favorites
features.text: Win rate and titles for each option, counting all completed plays.

faq.question: How does a tournament bracket work?
faq.answer: The options are drawn into a bracket and face off in pairs. In each duel the player picks one, and it moves on to the next round until the final. With 8 options there are 7 duels; with 16, 15; with 32, 31; and with 64, 63.

faq.question: Can I make a bracket with 32 or 64 options?
faq.answer: Yes. Brackets with 8 and 16 options are free; 32 and 64 options are part of QuestioPlus. Without a subscription, a one-time pass unlocks the big bracket you're making, and it stays unlocked afterwards. Big brackets work well on streams and videos, with more rounds before the champion.

faq.question: Can I use images?
faq.answer: Yes. Each option can have a text, an image or both. Images in tournaments are free.

faq.question: Does everyone get the same bracket?
faq.answer: No. The bracket is drawn again on every play, so the matchups change and the overall ranking is fairer.

faq.question: Where do I see the most chosen options?
faq.answer: On the tournament's results tab: each option shows its win rate in duels and how many times it was champion.

tournament.finalText: Create your tournament in a few minutes and send it to your friends.
tournament.cardText: Options face off in a bracket until a champion is left.

faq.question: How do I create an interactive story?
faq.answer: Write the first scene and its choices, then point each choice to another scene or to an ending. Keep going until every path ends, and publish.

faq.question: How many endings can a story have?
faq.answer: As many as you want, within the limit of 60 scenes. The story needs at least one ending that players can reach from the start.

faq.question: Can two choices lead to the same scene?
faq.answer: Yes. Paths can meet again, and a choice can even go back to an earlier scene.

faq.question: What does the player see at the end?
faq.answer: The ending they reached, with its title and text, how many choices it took and how many endings the story has.

faq.question: Is it like a choose your own adventure book?
faq.answer: Yes. Just like in a choose your own adventure book or any interactive fiction, each choice leads to another scene, and the player decides the path to one of the endings. Here the choices are buttons, so there are no pages to flip, and the story works on a phone.

faq.question: How does a compatibility test work?
faq.answer: You write the questions and answer them first. Then you send the invite link, and each person who answers is compared with you: the result shows how many answers are the same and the percentage.

faq.question: Who can see my answers?
faq.answer: Only the people you are compared with. The person you invited sees your answers next to theirs, and you see the answers of the people who answered through your link. Anyone else who opens a result link sees only the percentage.

faq.question: Do players need an account?
faq.answer: No. They only need to enter a name, because the other person sees it in the comparison.

faq.question: Can I invite more than one person?
faq.answer: Yes. The same link works for as many people as you like, and each one gets their own comparison with you. Your result shows who answered through it.

faq.question: How is it different from an About me quiz?
faq.answer: In an About me quiz, friends try to guess your answers and compete on a leaderboard. In a compatibility test there is no right answer: each person answers about themselves, and the result shows how much you have in common.

scored.lead: Give each answer from -100 to 100 points and split the totals into ranges, such as “Couch adventurer” or “Born adventurer”. At the end, each player sees their score and the result for their range. It works for fun quizzes and for self-assessments, like study or work habits.

steps.title: Give the answers points
steps.text: Each answer is worth from -100 to 100 points. Negative points are subtracted from the total.

steps.title: Set the ranges
steps.text: Split the possible totals into 2 to 10 ranges, each with a title and a text. The editor shows the lowest and highest possible total and can split the points evenly for you.

features.title: Points per answer

features.title: Ranges checked for you

features.title: Result with the score

faq.question: How does a points quiz work?
faq.answer: Each answer is worth a number of points. When the player finishes, the points are added up and the total falls into one of the ranges you created, which gives the result.

faq.question: Can answers take points away?
faq.answer: Yes. Each answer can be worth from -100 to 100 points, so you can use negative points to lower the total.

faq.question: How many ranges can I create?
faq.answer: From 2 to 10. Ranges can't overlap, and every possible total has to fall into one of them; the editor shows what is missing before you publish.

faq.question: How is it different from a personality quiz?
faq.answer: In a personality quiz each answer points to a profile, and the most picked profile wins. In a points quiz the answers add up and the result depends on the total, which works well for “how much” questions, like how adventurous or organized someone is.

faq.question: What is a weighted quiz?
faq.answer: A quiz where answers carry different weights. Here each answer is worth from -100 to 100 points, so a strong answer can count more than a mild one, and the total decides the result.

faq.question: Can I make a self-assessment?
faq.answer: Yes. Write questions about habits, such as studying or staying organized, and give more points to the answers that show the behavior you want to measure. Each range tells people where they stand and can suggest a next step.

scored.finalTitle: How many points will your players score?
scored.finalText: Start from the example or write your own questions and ranges.
scored.cardText: Answers are worth points, and the total gives the result.

cross.title: Prefer results by profile?
cross.text: In a personality quiz each answer points to a profile, such as a character or a style, and the most picked one is the result.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes. Go to Settings in the menu. QuestioPlus stays active until the end of the month you already paid for, and it won't renew.

items.question: What happens to my quizzes if I cancel?
items.answer: They stay published, as they are. Quizzes where you used paid features stay unlocked, including for editing. To use paid features on new quizzes, subscribe again or use a pass. Ads will show on your quizzes again.

items.question: What's the difference between monthly and the pass?
items.answer: Monthly unlocks the paid features on all your quizzes and experiences while it's active, and removes their ads. The pass is a one-time payment that unlocks the paid features on one quiz or bracket, without removing ads. If you create often, monthly costs less.

items.question: How is a pass used?
items.answer: It's used when you save a quiz or bracket that uses paid features, and that quiz stays unlocked for good. If you buy more than one, they stay in your account until you use them.

items.question: Which payment methods can I use?
items.answer: The available methods show up at checkout, depending on your country. Payments are processed by Stripe, and QuestioFlux never sees your card details.

final.title: Ready to create?
